keyEvents.text: Darren Yapi (Colorado Rapids) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Donavan Phillip (Colorado Rapids).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Colorado Rapids 1, Minnesota United FC 0. Darren Yapi (Colorado Rapids) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Keegan Rosenberry with a cross.
Second Half begins Colorado Rapids 1, Minnesota United FC 0.
Goal! Colorado Rapids 1, Minnesota United FC 1. Kelvin Yeboah (Minnesota United FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
